title: Vessel Manager
description:
Seaspan employees are goal\-driven and thrive in a high\-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life\-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long\-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry\-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.
   

  

**Position Description:**
 The Vessel Manager is responsible for the safe, reliable and economical operation of assigned vessels. The position applies knowledge of engineering, HR\-management, shipping\-industry regulations, commercial and legal considerations, and guides sea\-staff onboard assigned vessels. The Vessel Manager also takes initiative to continuously improve the performance of assigned ships and strengthens the teamwork between ship and office.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities:**
* To be familiar with the Health, Safety, Environmental Protection and Quality Policy (PL\-005\), and understands the responsibilities under the Environmental Management System (EMS).  In keeping with this and other compliance policies, they understand their duty to report any environmental noncompliance and/or concern to their manager or members either of the senior management team (including the highest level of management) directly or through the open reporting system as per Management System guidelines
* Guides, advises, and monitor vessel operations; also assists crew performing vessel maintenance
* Researches technical information related to equipment breakdowns, malfunctions, improvements, upgrades or modifications for the reliable long\-term performance of the vessels
* Prepares for scheduled dry dockings, surveys and repairs on assigned ships, and arranges and manages supply of spares, stores, and services to vessels before scheduled maintenance and breakdown repairs
* Manages vessels in full compliance with local and international rules and regulations; and with Seaspan’s Safety Management System (SMS)
* Analyses ships’ performance and relays this information to the onboard master and chief engineer; ensures compliance with current charter\-party terms of employment and other commercial concerns
* Ensures compliance with all necessary operational certification and survey requirements applicable to assigned vessels
* Visits vessels port; may sail with Seaspan ships to reasonably ascertain that they are operated in a safe, reliable and economical way
* Monitors function and performance during ship visits and initiates effective problem solving of on\-board issues, including technical, quality\-assurance, health and safety, commercial or personnel issues
* Takes ownership of on\-board issues and follows them through to resolution
* Prepares budgets in the required detail for the yearly operation of assigned ships, scheduled dry dockings, surveys, repairs and ad\-hoc modifications and repairs within required timelines
* Monitors expenses of assigned vessels and submits monthly variance reporting and tracks against budget
* Ensures that all reporting employees adhere to company policies and procedures
* Communicates expectations to direct reports; manages performance and provides leadership and support to team members
* Demonstrates commitment to Seaspan’s Maritime Resource Management values
* Performs other duties as required


**Requirements:**
* Must have at least one year of experience as a technical superintendent in a company managing handy\-max sized (or larger) vessels engaged in international trading and must have a minimum of one full year in rank as a chief engineer or have completed three contracts as a chief engineer with Seaspan
* English language skills, both verbal and written, must be effective and suitable for a multi\-cultural working environment
* Strong technical knowledge
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite (including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint and Excel)
* Class 1 marine engineer certificate
* Degree in marine engineering or equivalent


**Additional Desired Qualifications:**
* Experience working with container ships
* Education in mechanical engineering or naval architecture
* Previous experience with new\-builds and dry\-dockings preferred


**Job Demands and/or Physical Requirements:**
* Regular international travel is required and may be on short notice
* Must have mobility to conduct vessel inspections
* Will be required to carry a mobile device and check regularly outside of office hours
* Must maintain a home internet connection for work outside of office hours


 Seaspan Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status. We thank all applicants in advance. If your application is shortlisted to be included in the interview process, one of our team will be in contact with you.

title: Business Manager (Growth Track) – Atleisure by Roology
description:
**Location:** 
 Mumbai (Andheri West)
 **Employment type:** 
 Full\-time
 **Reports to:** 
 Founder
 **Team:** 
 1 intern will report to this role
 **Start date:** 
 October 1, 2026
 **Compensation:** 
 ₹25,000/month for the first 3 months, reviewed alongside the promotion decision below
 


 About Atleisure
 
 Atleisure by Roology is the newest label from Roology, a Mumbai\-based D2C womenswear brand. Atleisure is built around ease, not hustle — elevated comfort wear for women who are done performing productivity 24/7\. We're early\-stage, fast\-moving, and building the brand and the business at the same time — which means this role won't look like a "job description" for very long. It'll evolve as fast as you do.
 


 About the role
 
 We're hiring a generalist who wants to grow into a true Business Manager role — someone who can sit across operations, marketing, and finance in these early months, acting as the connective tissue between the founder, our vendors, our PR/social team, and everyone else keeping Atleisure running day to day. You'll also have an intern working under you from day one — so alongside learning the business, you'll be getting your first experience directing someone else's work.
 



 This is deliberately a
 **growth\-track role** 
 : you'll start hands\-on across all three functions, learning the business from the inside out. Based on performance, you'll be formally reviewed for promotion to
 **Business Manager within 3 months** 
 — with a compensation review at the same time — taking on greater ownership and ambiguity as you prove you can run with it.
 



 If you're early in your career and the idea of learning ops, marketing, and finance simultaneously at a founder's side — rather than being boxed into one narrow function — genuinely excites you, this is built for you.
 


 What you'll do
 
**Operations** 



* Coordinate day\-to\-day operations — vendor follow\-ups, order fulfillment tracking, inventory coordination
* Handle customer queries and support — order status, pre\- and post\-sales questions, and escalations
* Direct and check in on the intern's work, making sure their output actually moves things forward
* Act as the point of contact between the founder and external teams (PR, vendors, freelancers), making sure nothing falls through the cracks
* Document processes as you learn them, so the business runs on systems, not on memory



**Marketing** 



* Own the weekly content/posting calendar in coordination with our social/PR team, keeping Instagram active and on\-schedule
* Track campaign and content performance, flag what's working and what isn't
* Support influencer and PR outreach coordination



**Finance** 



* Track expenses, vendor payments, and basic budget\-vs\-actuals
* Support the founder in monthly financial reviews and reporting
* Flag discrepancies or gaps early, rather than after they've become a problem



**Mediator, across all of it** 



* Translate the founder's priorities into action across teams, and surface what each team needs back up to the founder
* Keep multiple moving parts (marketing, ops, finance, external vendors) talking to each other instead of operating in silos


 What we're looking for
 
**Skills** 



* Strong written and verbal communication — you'll be the go\-between for multiple people and functions, and customer\-facing at times
* Comfortable with spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets) for tracking and reporting
* Organized, detail\-oriented, able to juggle several open threads without dropping any
* Basic familiarity with Instagram/social platforms and e\-commerce (Shopify) is a plus, not a requirement



**Attitude** 



* Genuinely seeks to learn — asks questions, follows up, doesn't wait to be told twice
* Comfortable with ambiguity and a startup pace where the job description shifts as the business does
* Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions on everything, and comfortable owning an intern's output as well as your own
* Resilient — early\-stage brands have setbacks and false starts, and we need someone who treats that as normal, not alarming



**Knowledge / background** 



* No prior experience in a specific function (ops, marketing, or finance) is required — full training will be provided
* Any prior exposure to D2C/e\-commerce, retail, or a startup environment is a bonus, not a must
* Freshers and early\-career candidates (0–2 years) are welcome to apply


 Why join
 * Direct mentorship from the founder, with real exposure to how a D2C brand is actually built and run
* Early people\-management experience — you'll have an intern supporting you from day one
* A defined growth path — a formal shot at the Business Manager title (and a compensation review) within your first 3 months, not a vague "maybe someday"
* The chance to shape a young brand's systems from the ground up, rather than inheriting someone else's playbook
* Part of the Roology family — access to the learning, processes, and network of an already\-running sister brand


 How to apply
 
 Email us at arushi@atleisureculture.com

title: Manager - Customer Service Transformation And AI
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Consulting –** 
**Manager\- Customer Service Transformation and AI**
**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The
 **Manager – Customer Service Transformation and AI** 
 will drive AI\-led service transformation initiatives within the Customer practice, combining service strategy, AI solution design, process improvement, and delivery excellence. The role will support clients in reimagining service journeys, contact centre operations, field service, and knowledge\-enabled support models through responsible use of AI, automation, analytics, and workflow orchestration. You will work with senior stakeholders to identify transformation opportunities, shape practical roadmaps, and deliver measurable improvements in customer experience, service productivity, resolution quality, and operating efficiency.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Business Development \& Market Leadership**
* Support the development of AI\-led service transformation opportunities across advisory and implementation engagements, contributing to pipeline growth and client relationship expansion.
* Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, solution narratives, and executive presentations focused on service modernization, AI adoption, and customer operations improvement.
* Support GTM development for AI\-enabled service offerings across sectors, including contact center transformation, intelligent case management, field service optimization, and digital self\-service.
* Develop reusable assets, accelerators, and points of view on AI\-led service transformation, customer operations, and service experience modernization.

**Client Engagement \& Delivery**

* Assess service processes, customer journeys, operating models, channel mix, agent workflows, knowledge management practices, and performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
* Design AI\-enabled service operating models, service blueprints, automation use cases, governance structures, and adoption roadmaps aligned to client business outcomes.
* Support implementation of AI use cases such as virtual agents, agent assist, intelligent routing, case summarization, sentiment insights, knowledge search, predictive service, and workflow automation.
* Partner with technology, data, and business teams to translate service pain points into business requirements, solution concepts, process maps, and delivery\-ready backlogs.
* Develop business cases and benefits models to quantify productivity gains, containment improvement, average handle time reduction, service quality improvement, and cost\-to\-serve impact.
* Ensure delivery quality across assigned workstreams, including scope management, stakeholder coordination, milestone tracking, issue resolution, and executive reporting.
* Support change management and adoption activities to improve stakeholder readiness, responsible AI usage, and operational sustainability.


**Technology \& Innovation**
* Enable teams to leverage AI, automation, analytics, CRM, contact center platforms, knowledge management systems, and workflow tools to improve service outcomes.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to define data, integration, and governance considerations required for AI\-enabled service transformation.
* Identify opportunities to build accelerators, prototypes, and reusable methods for AI\-enabled service discovery, solution design, and benefits tracking.


**Leadership \& People Development**
* Manage small to mid\-sized project teams or workstreams, ensuring high\-quality deliverables, structured problem solving, and timely execution.
* Coach consultants and analysts on service transformation methods, requirements structuring, stakeholder engagement, and AI\-led operating model design.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Experience with AI\-enabled service use cases such as virtual agents, agent assist, intelligent routing, case summarization, and predictive service insights.
* Exposure to service platforms such as Salesforce Service Cloud, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service, ServiceNow CSM, Genesys, NICE, Amazon Connect, or similar technologies.
* Industry experience across B2B, professional services, technology, manufacturing, consumer, healthcare, utilities, or financial services sectors.


**What We Look For**
* 8\+ years of experience in service transformation, customer operations, contact center transformation, field service transformation, digital service, or AI\-enabled operations improvement.
* Consulting experience is desired.
* Proven experience supporting or leading service transformation initiatives from assessment through implementation planning and adoption.
* Strong understanding of service journeys, contact center operations, case management, knowledge management, service KPIs, and customer experience improvement levers.
* Hands\-on experience with AI, automation, analytics, CRM, service platforms, or digital workflow tools in customer service environments.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, problem\-solving, and project delivery skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

**About the Company** 




 BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. Its a leading service provider for the mid\-markets with client service at its heart.
 



  





 BDO India Services Private Limited (or BDO India) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory \& assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300\+ Partners \& Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3\-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi\-fold.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 BDO India is seeking a detail\-oriented and process\-driven Assistant Manager – CRM Data Management \& Operations to oversee the integrity, quality, and governance of customer and business development data within Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365\).
 



  





 The role will be responsible for driving CRM data quality initiatives, managing stakeholder data requests, ensuring compliance with Master Data Management (MDM) standards, supporting user onboarding and access management, and partnering with internal teams to continuously improve CRM processes and data governance practices.
 



  





 This position requires strong analytical capabilities, hands\-on CRM administration experience, stakeholder management skills, and a proactive approach to driving operational excellence.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**CRM Data Governance \& Quality Management** 



* Ensure the completeness, accuracy, consistency, and integrity of CRM data across Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Quotes, and Orders.
* Conduct regular audits of CRM records against defined MDM standards and implement corrective actions to address data quality gaps.
* Lead data cleansing, de\-duplication, validation, and enrichment initiatives to improve overall CRM data health.
* Maintain and monitor CRM data quality scorecards, identifying trends, risks, and areas requiring remediation.
* Track compliance with CRM data entry standards across business units and prepare periodic management reports.
* Identify recurring data quality issues and recommend process improvements to strengthen governance controls.
* Maintain documentation including data dictionaries, governance guidelines, audit logs, and process documentation.



  





**CRM Operations \& Data Request Management** 



* Manage the firm's CRM Data Request Management process, ensuring timely and accurate resolution of stakeholder requests.
* Review and approve account creation requests in line with established governance protocols.
* Facilitate backend creation and maintenance of Accounts, Contacts, and Leads within D365\.
* Ensure adherence to defined service levels for all requests:
* Standard Requests – Within 3 business days
* Priority Requests – Within 1 business day

title: Senior Manager MEP- (PPM Consultant)
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
   

  

 We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
   

  

**Role description:**
 The Senior Manager – MEP will lead MEP design, coordination, and project management activities for major international construction projects. This role is part of the Design Assurance \& Value Engineering (DA\&VE) team within the Client’s Centre of Excellence (COE) Team and is responsible for ensuring designs align with client briefs, project goals, and industry standards, while driving innovation and sustainability across all MEP services. The position demands technical oversight, strong stakeholder engagement, and effective contribution to project delivery within a global, multidisciplinary environment. This role will be providing services on a variety of large programs being undertaken globally. Accordingly, this role must be prepared to work hours appropriate to a global delivery model.
   

  

**Role accountabilities:**
* Design Coordination \& Discipline Integration: Review and validate MEP designs, drawings, and calculations to ensure alignment with the client brief while coordinating with architectural and structural disciplines to resolve clashes and ensure seamless system integration.
* Techno\-Commercial Analysis: Conduct comprehensive techno\-commercial evaluations of MEP schemes and innovative technologies, ensuring that all adopted strategies are cost\-effective, high\-performing, and aligned with the project's commercial design intent.
* Strategic Stakeholder Liaison: Act as the primary technical link between client teams, consultants, and senior management, translating complex technical MEP concepts into transparent project updates and actionable insights.
* Value Engineering \& Sustainability Innovation: Drive value engineering initiatives to identify cost\-saving opportunities and integrate sustainable design principles, energy\-efficient measures, and smart building technologies across all MEP systems.
* Technical Oversight \& Quality Assurance: Oversee the integrity of technical specifications within tender documentation and ensure all designs comply with international building codes, safety regulations, and professional ethical standards.
* Commissioning Strategy \& Handover: Lead the commissioning, testing, and verification process of MEP systems to ensure peak performance and manage the successful handover of documentation and system designs to the Capital Management team.
* Project Governance \& Risk Mitigation: Manage the flow of technical information between external contractors and internal teams, while contributing to the project risk register to identify and mitigate potential MEP\-related operational challenges.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
* A Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering is the minimum educational requirement.
* A minimum of 10 to 12 years of experience in MEP design, coordination, project management and Commissioning management.
* Experience working on the client side, or within a consultancy role, managing the client's interests and acting as their representative, is highly valued.
* Demonstrating a strong understanding of MEP systems (High side \& low side), including HVAC, Electrical, Firefighting, IBMS and plumbing systems, along with a deep familiarity with relevant international building codes, standards, and regulations, is essential.
* A good grasp of the construction process, including site issues, coordination with contractors, and installation oversight, is crucial.

title: Head of Information Technology
description:
**About Us:** 
 Heather Grey is a global uniforms supplier to top brands in Food Service, Hospitality, and Aviation – McDonald’s, KFC and Hilton Hotels being just some examples.
 



 We’ve been in the business for over 20 years and have consistently grown from a team of 2 people to over 150 today. We’re well known amongst the clients we serve and come with some brand recognition.
 



 Our office at Peninsula Corporate Park in Lower Parel is our beating heart – with high energy, intelligent, and motivated colleagues, and a dynamic work environment with tight collaboration across domains. You have to see it to feel it!
 



  
 



**Skills and Role:** 
 You will own technology at Heather Grey – both keeping the things we already run working, and building the things we don’t have yet. We don’t have specific requirements for your background – we just need you to be hands\-on, curious about how the business actually works, and comfortable being the person everyone comes to when something breaks.
 



 Some things you will be doing at work are –
 



 1\.   Own our systems end to end – ERP, orders, production and inventory data – and make sure they tell us the truth
 



 2\.   Build or buy what we’re missing, and automate the work our teams currently do by hand
 



 3\.   Connect us to our customers’ systems – portals, EDI, forecasts – so orders flow without someone re\-typing them
 



 4\.   Keep the basics solid – devices, networks, access, backups and security across our offices and partner sites
 



 5\.   Manage our vendors and budgets, and be honest about what’s worth paying for
 



 6\.   Sit with the leadership team on where technology should take us next
 



  
 



**Education and Experience:** 
 We don’t care so much about degrees or years of experience, so don’t let the list below deter you from applying, but generally, these might be helpful indicators that you’re the right person for the job \-
 



 1\. Engineering, computer science or equivalent
 



 2\. 5\+ years of work experience, some of it owning systems rather than just supporting them
 



 3\. Have worked with an ERP or similar business system, ideally in manufacturing, retail or supply chain
 



 4\. Can still get your hands dirty – a script, a query, a spreadsheet that does the job

**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group** 
 : Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Adani Airports Holding Limited** 
 : Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state\-of\-the\-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world\-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 Executive \- Building Management Systems (BMS) is responsible for overseeing the engineering, maintenance, and operational management of all BMS systems within the airport. This includes ensuring the proper functioning, reliability, and performance of systems such as HVAC, lighting, fire alarm systems, access control, and other integrated mechanical, electrical, and civil systems that are controlled through BMS. The role ensures preventive and corrective maintenance, and manage troubleshooting for BMS\-related issues across airport facilities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**BMS System Engineering \& Maintenance:**
 Lead the engineering, installation, commissioning, and maintenance of BMS systems, ensuring that they operate efficiently, reliably, and in compliance with airport standards.
   

  

 Oversee the day\-to\-day operation of BMS infrastructure, including HVAC, lighting, electrical systems, fire alarm systems, and access controls, ensuring their seamless integration with other airport systems.
   

  

 Ensure continuous monitoring, testing, and updating of BMS systems to maintain optimal performance levels across all facilities.
   

  

 Develop and execute maintenance schedules for BMS systems, ensuring proper preventive maintenance and minimal downtime.
   

  

**Troubleshooting And Fault Resolution**
 Lead troubleshooting efforts in case of system failures, quickly diagnosing faults within BMS\-related systems and resolving issues with minimal disruption to airport operations.
   

  

 Coordinate with engineering teams to repair or replace faulty components of BMS systems, ensuring efficient and timely resolutions.
   

  

 Implement diagnostic tools and technologies to identify potential issues before they impact the operations of the airport.
   

  

**Energy Efficiency And Sustainability**
 Monitor and optimize energy consumption across airport facilities by utilizing BMS for HVAC systems, lighting, and electrical load management.
   

  

 Implement energy\-saving initiatives through BMS systems, ensuring energy optimization and contributing to the airport’s sustainability goals.
   

  

 Evaluate the performance of BMS systems in managing energy usage, recommending improvements for greater cost savings and environmental benefits.
   

  

**Safety And Regulatory Compliance**
 Ensure that all BMS systems comply with airport\-specific safety standards, industry regulations, and local environmental health and safety guidelines.
   

  

 Conduct regular safety audits and inspections on BMS\-related systems, ensuring proper documentation and compliance with safety standards such as fire safety, electrical safety, and hazard control.
   

  

 Assist in the development and updating of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for BMS operation and maintenance to ensure a safe environment for all stakeholders.
   

  

**Budget Planning \& Forecasting**
 Develop and manage the annual budget for BMS operations, including system maintenance, upgrades, energy\-saving initiatives, and staffing.
   

  

 Prepare detailed budget forecasts, considering historical data, upcoming projects, and planned system enhancements to ensure adequate financial planning.
   

  

**BMS Performance Monitoring**
 Lead the monitoring of BMS data for system performance, energy usage, and operational efficiency, utilizing system dashboards and reports.
   

  

 Analyze system data to detect performance trends and inefficiencies, implementing corrective measures as necessary.
   

  

 Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to BMS system uptime, reliability, and energy consumption to ensure continuous improvement.
   

  

**Vendor And Contractor Management**
 Oversee relationships with third\-party vendors and contractors responsible for BMS system components or services, ensuring high\-quality service delivery and compliance with contractual obligations.
   

  

 Coordinate with vendors for the timely procurement of equipment, materials, and parts required for the maintenance and repair of BMS systems.
   

  

 Manage vendor service level agreements (SLAs) and ensure that maintenance and repair activities are performed within specified time frames and quality standards.
   

  

**Team Leadership And Development**
 Lead and supervise the BMS engineering and maintenance team, providing guidance, training, and mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
   

  

 Develop and implement training programs to improve the technical skills and knowledge of the BMS team.
   

  

 Ensure proper documentation of maintenance activities and work orders, ensuring that team members follow industry best practices and safety guidelines.
   

  

**Project Management And System Upgrades**
 Lead BMS system upgrade projects, including design, installation, and commissioning, ensuring alignment with airport’s engineering objectives and timelines.
   

  

 Plan and manage engineering projects related to BMS integration with other airport systems, ensuring minimal disruption to ongoing operations during implementation.
   

  

 Assist in evaluating and selecting new BMS technologies and tools to enhance operational capabilities.
   

  

**Reporting And Documentation**
 Provide regular reports on the status and performance of BMS systems, including energy usage, maintenance activities, and system health.
   

  

 Maintain detailed records of system configurations, maintenance logs, troubleshooting reports, and compliance audits to ensure transparency and accountability.
   

  

 Document system updates, troubleshooting efforts, and any changes to BMS configurations, ensuring all data is current and easily accessible for future reference.
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
 Head \- Engineering Services
   

  

 Maintenance Team
   

  

 Facility Management Team
   

  

 Operations Team
   

  

 Procurement Team
   

  

 Safety and Compliance Team
   

  

 Project Management Team
   

  

 IT Support Team
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- External**
 Clients/Building Owners
   

  

 Contractors and Subcontractors
   

  

 Equipment Vendors and Suppliers
   

  

 Regulatory Authorities
   

  

 Third\-Party Auditors
   

  

 Consultants and Design Engineers
   

  

 Service Providers for System Upgrades and Maintenance
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualifications:**
 Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
   

  

 Certification in Building Management Systems (BMS) or similar, such as from the Building Controls Industry Association (BCIA) or equivalent
   

  

 Additional certifications in HVAC, electrical systems, or energy management are a plus
   

  

 Professional engineering license (depending on the country/region)
   

  

**Work Experience**
 10\+ years of experience working with BMS systems, including hands\-on installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting
   

  

 Proven experience in managing teams and leading projects within the BMS or building automation industry
   

  

 Strong background in working with control systems, HVAC, lighting, and energy management solutions
   

  

 Experience collaborating with contractors, clients, and other engineering teams on large\-scale building projects

title: Store Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Kapsons Fashion, founded in 1989, is a leading fashion retail chain in North India and one of the first organizations to bring multiple international brands under one roof. With close to 25 stores across 20 cities and more than 100 global brands, Kapsons has established itself as a one\-stop destination for global fashion. The company has expanded its portfolio with Kapkids and Miss Kapsons, further strengthening its presence in diverse customer segments. For over 30 years, Kapsons has been trusted and loved by customers for offering renowned brands such as Tommy Hilfiger, Puma, Vero Moda, Armani Exchange, Louis Philippe, U.S. Polo, Jack \& Jones, and many more. Team members join a dynamic, growth\-focused environment with strong brand partnerships and a customer\-centric culture.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Store Manager role based in Mumbai. The Store Manager is responsible for overseeing daily store operations, including staff supervision, sales performance monitoring, and ensuring adherence to company standards and policies. The role involves driving customer satisfaction through excellent service, managing visual merchandising and inventory levels, and implementing retail loss prevention practices. The Store Manager will coordinate scheduling, training, and performance feedback for store team members, while maintaining a safe, clean, and engaging shopping environment. The position also includes analyzing sales reports, supporting promotional activities, and collaborating with regional management to meet and exceed store targets.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong customer\-focused skills, including Customer Satisfaction and Customer Service.
* Effective Communication abilities for interacting with customers, team members, and management.
* Proficiency in Store Management, covering daily operations, staff supervision, and sales tracking.
* Knowledge of Retail Loss Prevention practices to safeguard inventory and minimize shrinkage.
* Previous experience in fashion or retail store management is highly preferred.
* Ability to lead and motivate diverse teams, with strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Comfort with using POS systems, basic MS Office tools, and interpreting sales and inventory data.
* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in retail management, business, or a related field.
* Availability to work flexible retail hours, including weekends, evenings, and holidays as needed.

 The Manager – IT Operations will be responsible for administering, securing, and governing the organization's enterprise IT platforms, identity management systems, business applications, network infrastructure, backup systems, and operational processes.
 



  





 The role requires a technically strong individual with hands\-on experience in Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Active Directory, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), DPDPA compliance controls, CRM administration, network administration, and enterprise application support.
 



  





 The incumbent will act as the primary owner for enterprise IT operations and will work closely with Information Security, Infrastructure, Compliance, and Business teams to ensure the availability, security, compliance, and performance of business\-critical systems. The position requires a candidate capable of operating at an L2/L3 administration level while driving operational excellence and governance initiatives across the organization.

**Enterprise Identity \& Access Management** 



* Administer Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Exchange Online, and Microsoft Intune environments.
* Manage enterprise identity lifecycle processes, including provisioning, role changes, access governance, and deprovisioning.
* Design, implement, and maintain Conditional Access Policies, Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Zero Trust security controls.
* Administer privileged access controls and PAM solutions to ensure secure access to critical systems.
* Conduct periodic access reviews, entitlement audits, and privilege validation exercises.
